name: LAYA research baseline v1
approved_by: user, chat 2026-10-13: GO steps 0, 1, 2 (step 1 = freeze a research baseline: pretrained head, three Fable-trained adapters, linear probe, with hashes)
status: research baseline, not a proven model-enhancement product. Files are referenced in place and never modified; nothing was copied or retrained.

pretrained_head.note: Laya Coding_Decision_Agent, Apache-2.0; 31 decision tensors, 26,248,193 parameters; never written

adapters.trained_on: all 334 pools of laya-fullaction-set-v3 with features (canonical TRAIN only), fit folds 1-4, checkpoint fold 0, seeds 0-2; adapter only, 5,246,982 parameters each
adapters.scoring_rule: each adapter scored alone; the reported figure is the mean of the three top-1 values (VAL 79.25, 81.13, 77.36). Any new evaluation uses this rule; an ensemble of scores is a different model.
adapters.verification: results/raw/laya-finetune-all-v1-20261012T080145Z/ADAPTER_VERIFICATION.json (loads cleanly, 31 pretrained tensors identical to the checkpoint)

linear_probe.what: logistic regression on the raw frozen-Qwen option states, standardised, class_weight balanced, C chosen from (1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1) by 3-fold grouped CV over trajectories
linear_probe.frozen_as: recipe + training data (the same 334 v3 TRAIN pools); deterministic, refitted at scoring time, no weights file. The mandatory baseline for every head result.

limits: agreement with Fable's recorded choice, not task success
the linear probe was stronger on every Fable test
alternatives written by other models: authorship shortcut
no untouched Fable TRAIN pool remains; CAL / TEST protected and never used
